exposure: maternal home systolic blood pressure (SBP) trajectory during pregnancy
maternal home diastolic blood pressure (DBP) trajectory during pregnancy
maternal home mean arterial pressure (MAP) trajectory during pregnancy
finding: Maternal home blood pressure trajectory during pregnancy was an indicator of infant birth weight, with most J-curve trajectory groups for SBP, DBP, and MAP significantly associated with lower infant birth weight compared to the low-J-curve group, ranging from -84 g to -567 g.
